propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards prod_impact and trigger_likelihood fields for maintenance findings, causing test-sufficiency findings to score at ~0.30 and remain advisory despite user-reach relevance.
Contract-contradicting assertions (test forbidding a state the same diff's contract declares allowed) are not detected as an antipattern, permitting escaped contradictions to ship.
Maintenance lane scoring applies uniform ×0.5 churn dampener to 80% of findings lacking churn90 data, compressing scores below the advisory threshold regardless of severity.

Code-v4 redesign must introduce forbids_contract_allowed_state binary, re-scope prod_impact/trigger_likelihood for guarded-path reach in both verify and tests lanes, and split maint-lane scoring by consequence/moderate/debt tiers with lane-scoped trigger maps and consequence-only reversibility floor.

Tests findings must route to blocking@0.54 threshold after v4 implementation, raising blocking rate from 3.4% (42/1243) to 8.0% (99/1243) with zero demotions of currently-blocking findings and no new validity floor violations.
